verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a payments platform, but the pack documents no user-configurable automation or workflow feature for Stripe Terminal. Webhooks are a developer building block for building your own reactions. Smart Disputes and offline payment auto-forwarding are narrow, fixed behaviors or adjacent features, not user-defined automations that run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
